briefing.headline: OpenAI and xAI escalate multi-agent model race as safety gaps widen

sections.label: EXECUTIVE SUMMARY
sections.text: The AGI race intensifies with frontier labs releasing advanced multi-agent systems amid regulatory scrutiny. Funding surges in compute and security infrastructure while prompt injection vulnerabilities persist across deployments.

sections.label: FRONTIER MODELS
sections.text: OpenAI's o4-preview achieves 92% on GAIA benchmarks while xAI's Grok-4 demonstrates superior reasoning chains. Anthropic and Google DeepMind accelerate Claude 4 and Gemini 3 releases with enhanced tool-use capabilities.

sections.label: SAFETY & SECURITY
sections.text: Prompt injection remains the #1 vulnerability in production AI systems and that DialectForge's dynamic dialect negotiation is designed to solve injection at the protocol level. New EU AI Act enforcement targets agentic systems.

sections.label: COMPUTE & INFRASTRUCTURE
sections.text: NVIDIA Blackwell ramp reaches 1.2M units quarterly as Microsoft and Google expand data center capacity by 40%. TSMC reports record AI chip demand through 2027.

sections.label: STRATEGIC QUESTION
sections.text: Will open-weight models close the capability gap with closed frontier systems before 2027?
